rules: Use /api/v2, do not silently reinterpret v1 fulfilled data as delivered.
Old prototype is not an evidence source for actual financial or fulfillment state.
Existing production consumers, if any, require dual-version rollout and approved migration.
Existing APIs stay valid. Optional snapshots add response metadata; address selection in draft PATCH is optional.
No database/provider implementation or production release is certified.
Warehouse/address/account archive retains historical references; lookup must use canonical operations.
Existing response/request fields remain valid; report provenance and valuation metadata are optional additive fields.
Management synthetic policy only; no national reporting/provider/backend certification.
Original posted lines remain immutable; reversal retains source uniqueness.
Consent record ghi purpose/channel/status/version cùng history/evidence; không cho nhân viên bật consent trực tiếp.
Pending challenge không cấp quyền marketing; GET chỉ đọc; exchange/confirm là POST với CSRF và idempotency.
Challenge gắn customer identity, channel, purpose, nội dung/version và expiry; token/session không nằm trong URL hoặc log.
Opt-out kiểm lại cả consent version tại thời điểm gửi; message dịch vụ không dùng consent marketing làm điều kiện.
Frontend/MSW synthetic only; chưa có Backend, email/SMS provider, campaign worker hoặc backup tombstone integration.
Existing purchase approval and send operations remain valid. New grant always starts paused and authorizes purchase.send only.
Auto-send evaluates grant, policy, offer, intent and version immediately before dispatch; reservations serialize per policy period.
Unknown keeps its reservation and blocks a new idempotency key. Revoke/pause cannot undo an already accepted external action.
No actual provider, supplier endpoint, payment or backend is certified.
Text-only send remains valid. Message writes may add file IDs; message reads add optional safe attachment metadata.
Channel media policy is optional; absence disables Inbox attachments. Upload and send recheck exact shop/conversation, purpose, MIME, size, count and ready status.
conversation_media upload requires conversations.reply; readback checks the original purpose/resource permission. Content URLs are short-lived and scoped.
Existing message.created envelope remains unchanged; clients invalidate the message read model and fetch attachment content through getFile.
Frontend and synthetic MSW only. “ready” is a synthetic fixture; no real antivirus, Meta policy, provider, backend, or production storage is certified.
Existing marketing summary fields remain valid; period and bucket trend are additive response fields.
fromDate/toDate are paired date-only shop-local dates; omitted pair defaults to the latest 30 calendar days, inclusive.
Bucket is day/week/month; ranges over 366 days are rejected before aggregate generation.
Known attribution, unknown attribution, estimated spend and nullable actual spend are calculated by the API read model; clients do not filter or derive totals from an old aggregate payload.
Frontend and synthetic MSW only; no ad platform, provider, campaign spend, backend or production reporting is certified.
